contracts.name: errors
names: R1.1 a failing chain read on GET /verdict answers 502 with the fixed body and no upstream detail
R1.2 any other unexpected error answers 500 with the fixed body and no error text
R1.3 both the 502 and the 500 write the full error to stderr
R1.4 deliberate errors keep their status and message (422, 413, 400)

contracts.name: evidence
names: R2.1 only job-<id>-<hex>.json files count; other job-<id>-* files are ignored even when newer
R2.2 a job with only non-matching files answers 404 like a job with no evidence

1.text: 1. Replace the catch-all `500 { error: e.message }` with the fixed body `{"error":"internal error"}` and log the full error to stderr; keep 400/413/422 unchanged (Req 1.2, 1.3, 1.4)

2.text: 2. Report a failing chain read in `GET /verdict/:jobId` as `502 {"error":"upstream chain read failed"}`, logging the full error to stderr (Req 1.1, 1.3)

3.text: 3. Make `GET /evidence/:jobId` match only `job-<jobId>-<hex>.json`, so other `job-<jobId>-*` files are ignored and a job with only those gets 404 (Req 2.1, 2.2)
